senses.gloss: (interchanging with אִסְרָטָא, סְרָטָא, trnsp. אסטרא; strata, sub. via, στρᾶτα S.) paved way, public road.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 20:17">Targ. Y. II, Num. XX, 17</cite> … <he>טה</he>; a. fr.—Y. Gitt. IV, beg. 45ᶜ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:1:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ</cite> top <he>גו א׳ וכ׳</he> on the road he heard &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:14">Tosef. Sabb. X</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:1">XI</cite>), 1 sq. (<cite ref="O01584"><he>סרטא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02558"><he>אסרטא</he></cite>, Var. <he>אסתרטא</he> with <cite ref="V00000"><he>ת</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:10">Ab. d’R. N. XXVIII</cite> life is like <he>לאיסטרטיא וכ׳</he> (read … <he>טא</he>) a public road running between two paths &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:7:2">Koh. R. to VII, 7</cite> <he>הוינא עקים אִסְטְרָטִי</he> I was bending my road, went out of my way.—Pl. <cite ref="A02412"><he>אִסְטְרָטַיָּא</he></cite>, (<cite ref="A02412"><he>אִסְטַרְטַיָּא</he></cite>, incorr. <cite ref="A02412"><he>אִסְטְרַטְיָא</he></cite>).

Targ. Y. Num. XX, 19.—אִסְטְרָטִין usu. the city walks, promenades (between the colonnades &c.). Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ bot. הוו מטיילין בא׳ were promenading &c. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵈ top; Cant. R. to V, 13; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ bot. אסטרין. [Deut. R. s. 3 אסטרטין, read אסטרטיגין.] [In Targ. mostly אִסְרָטִין, אסטרין.]
